# Every <leader> mapping of LazyVim v16.0.2 (commit 0fa4a847929fc6beae40a3063615a58115678c34,
# 2026-11-08), default specs and extras (research R-06). Produced in a clone of
# https://github.com/LazyVim/LazyVim at tag v16.0.2 with:
#   { grep -rhoE '"<leader>[^"]*"' lua/lazyvim | sed 's/^"//; s/"$//'
#     grep -rhoE "'<leader>[^']*'" lua/lazyvim | sed "s/^'//; s/'$//"
#     for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9; do echo "<leader>$i"; done
#   } | grep -vx '<leader>' | LC_ALL=C sort -u
# The loop adds the keys extras/editor/harpoon2.lua builds as "<leader>" .. i.
